title: WMT41 — FCt test mode entry
description: My Cycle + Soil + Power within 10 s; FCt display; tests 1–4 for motor, spin, fuzzy weigh, inlet valves.

steps.title: Prepare for test mode
steps.body: Empty tub. Within 10 s of power on/off, press My Cycle and Soil together, then Power.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Within 10 seconds press My Cycle and Soil together then Press Power.

steps.title: FCt test mode
steps.body: Display shows FCt — if not, replace PCB. My Cycle = wash test (L1, 3 min); Temp = spin/clutch/pump; Water Level = fuzzy weighing; Soil = inlet valves + software version.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Digital shows FCt. My cycle = washing test; Temp = spinning test.
